org.tmt.aps.peas.common

Class FloatPointListEncoder

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.common.FloatPointListEncoder

  • public class FloatPointListEncoder
extends Object
    Utility functions to encode and decode lists of FloatPoints from a string representation to Lists and Arrays. Also includes functions to encode and decode lists of x coordinates only and lists of y coordinates only. Includes list manipulation functions specific to floating point coordinates. Includes functions to extract x and y coordinates from lists and arrays of FloatPoints
    Author:
    smichaels
